role: UserDefaults-backed cache of processed SleepData per night (up to 14 nights) so morning processing / RR collector can read sleep without re-querying HealthKit.
types: SleepDataCache.Store: struct (private) — Codable list of entries
state: ud:SleepDataCache.v1 (retired key, removed on every save and on clear)

units.does: Computes the morning dayKey for recordingStart, loads the store and returns the SleepData whose dayKey is within 25h of that target and closest to it; nil otherwise. Callers (HealthKitManager+Sleep.swift:447, MorningProcessingService+Sleep.swift:102, RRCollector+OvernightStreaming.swift:404) must check plausiblyBelongsToRecording.

branches.cond: loadStore returns nil (no data or decode failure)
branches.effect: returns nil (cache miss), else filters/min-selects entries

flags.text: Entries are written keyed by startOfDay(SleepData.date) (line 59) but looked up by a recording-start-derived morning key with +-25h tolerance and nearest-wins, so with the target night missing it returns an adjacent night; correctness relies on every caller applying plausiblyBelongsToRecording (comment lines 50-52).

units.does: Writes SleepData into the store keyed by startOfDay(data.date), replacing any same-day entry, sorts newest first, truncates to 14 entries, and saves. Called from HealthKitManager+Sleep.swift:133 and HealthKitManager+SleepTrends.swift:519.

branches.effect: ?? fallback: start an empty Store (an undecodable existing store is overwritten, its entries lost)
true: keep the 14 newest; false: keep all

units.does: Removes SleepDataCache.v2 and the retired SleepDataCache.v1 from UserDefaults. Called by DataPurgeService.swift:700.
Maps a recording start time to the start of the day of the morning its sleep belongs to: hour>=16 -> next day start, else same day start.

branches.effect: ?? fallback hour 0 (treated as morning, same day)
true: next calendar day startOfDay; false: falls to same-day startOfDay

flags.text: Comment at line 41-42 says recordings before local 4 AM map to the morning AFTER, otherwise the recording's own morning; the code uses a 16:00 cutoff (16:00-23:59 -> next day, 00:00-15:59 -> same day), matching the inner comment at lines 79-80 but not the outer one.

units.does: Loads and JSON-decodes the Store from SleepDataCache.v2.

branches.effect: returns nil; else decodes via attempt (decode error logged, returns nil)

units.does: Encodes the Store and saves it under SleepDataCache.v2, then removes retired keys.

branches.effect: true: data written; false: encode error logged by attempt, store not written (retired keys still removed)
